Canonical subject stays `place:Q24451`, the national park. This is an editorial preparation revision, version 2, not publication. All checks and decision remain pending; no reviewer, advisory acknowledgment or receipt exists.

## Source correspondence

The dated research-action ledger records each inspected URL, purpose, outcome and limit. The existing Wikidata identity evidence is retained without pretending it was newly retrieved. SANParks sources were freshly inspected.

- Lake Panic: the Skukuza camp page lists the hide outside the camp. Copy distinguishes the camp boundary from the park and removes the promise of quiet.
- Masorini: official descriptions support reconstructed structures and BaPhalaborwa iron working. No historical superlatives or guided-tour availability claims are carried over.
- Albasini: official evidence supports nineteenth-century trading-post remains at Phabeni. No route duration or opening assertion is included.
- Letaba: the museum overview supports biology/research themes; the camp page corroborates location. September 2026 flood-recovery news describes progress with work remaining, not a guarantee that the museum or every road is open on future dates. Durable institutional wording plus current-guidance advice replaces the unresolved preparation recheck.
- Skukuza: a southern camp base on the Sabie River, not a base next to every northern attraction.
- Transport/safety: current park rules support designated vehicle-exit areas, permitted roads and gate compliance. No medical advice, sighting promise, schedules or prices were added.

## Albanian preparation

Replaced “site arkeologjike” with “vende arkeologjike”; bird hide is described as “strehë për vëzhgimin e shpendëve”; trading post as “pikë tregtare”. Masorini wording retains BaPhalaborwa and describes iron working. Proper site/camp names remain intact; surrounding wording distinguishes a camp from the entire park. Vehicle-exit wording explicitly limits leaving the vehicle to permitted areas. This is language preparation, not human editorial approval.
